transcript.content: Hi, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

Well, I guess what brings me here is that my talking gets all mixed up. I try to explain things to people—like, I'll start talking about the keys for the building, and then the jail, and then the prayer rug, then chess pieces... and people just stop me and tell me they cannot follow what I am saying at all. It just gets jumbled up when I try to get it out, and they don't understand me.
Have you been feeling unusually high, euphoric, or irritable lately?

Yeah, I have. There are times when I feel just... so high and powerful. I'll be laughing and talking real loud with everyone I see. But then, if someone questions me about something, I can just snap. I'll end up shouting at them over some small little thing.
Have you been hearing voices that other people cannot hear?

Yeah, I do. Sometimes when I'm working, I'll hear a man's voice. It usually comes from the air vents or... or from inside the mop closet. He'll call my name, or he'll tell me that I ruined everything. And I mean, it sounds completely real. It sounds exactly like there's a guy standing right there next to me, just talking to me. But there's never anyone there.
Have there been times when you heard that voice even when you were not feeling especially high or irritable?

Yeah, definitely. There have been times... well, whole weeks, really, where my mood was just fine. I wasn't feeling all revved up and high, and I wasn't feeling down in the dumps either. Just kind of steady. But even then... for more than two weeks straight, I was still hearing that man's voice coming from the vents. And I was still absolutely sure that the people working in the building were sending secret signals about me to each other. So, yeah, the voice and the signals... they don't stop just because my mood calms down.
Have you also had times when you felt very depressed for days at a time?

Yeah, I have those times too. On my bad days, I just... I sit on the edge of the bed after my morning prayer, and I just feel heavy. Empty. Like there's just no point in even cleaning myself up or going outside. It just feels like too much.
During those depressed times, did you still hear the man's voice?

I'm not really sure about that. When I get that down, it's... it's hard to pay attention to much of anything, honestly. Everything just kind of blurs together. So I can't say for sure if the voice was there during those times or not.
During those low periods, have you ever felt depressed most of the day, nearly every day, for at least two weeks?

Yeah, they definitely go on for at least two weeks at a time. Honestly, if I add it all up... since this whole thing started, those heavy, hopeless periods have probably amounted to about seven months total.
Have there been times when the voice or the secret signals happened only when you were feeling high or irritable?
No, I don't think so. The voice and the signals... they don't just happen when I'm feeling high or wired. They happen at other times too, not just when I'm in those moods.
Overall, since these problems began, have the depressed periods made up most of the time you’ve been ill?

No, not the depressed times. Honestly, most of the time since this whole thing started, I've been in those... those keyed-up stretches. You know, where I'm talking too much, coming up with these impossible plans to clean the whole building top to bottom in one night... just feeling totally driven, like I can't slow down no matter what. That's been most of it.
